item_name: Rothco Alice Pack Frame Shoulder Straps
item_short_desc: Rothco’s ALICE Pack Frame Shoulder Straps are designed to attach seamlessly to your ALICE pack frame, providing essential support for carrying heavy loads. These shoulder straps are made to fit all standard LC-1 packs, making them a versatile and reliable choice for your outdoor gear. The shoulder padding helps to distribute the weight of your ALICE pack more evenly, significantly reducing shoulder strain and enhancing comfort during extended use.
description: Rothco’s ALICE Pack Frame Shoulder Straps are designed to attach seamlessly to your ALICE pack frame, providing essential support for carrying heavy loads. These shoulder straps are made to fit all standard LC-1 packs, making them a versatile and reliable choice for your outdoor gear. The shoulder padding helps to distribute the weight of your ALICE pack more evenly, significantly reducing shoulder strain and enhancing comfort during extended use. Part of the ALICE (All-Purpose Lightweight Individual Carrying Equipment) system, originally developed for military personnel in the 1960s, these straps are built for durability and endurance. Whether you’re camping, backpacking, or even putting together a Halloween costume, Rothco’s ALICE Pack Frame Shoulder Straps are a practical and supportive accessory. Upgrade your ALICE pack with these high-quality shoulder straps to experience improved comfort and functionality.
